generator: OpenAI built-in image generation operated by the WikiBiome control task
reviewStandard: The WikiBiome control task supplied literal prompt provenance, generated-original identifiers, SHA-256-verifiable draft files, and human original-resolution audits for all accepted and rejected outputs. Prompt counts are not evidence. Only the six control-accepted outputs are eligible for deterministic processing; Borrelia revision 1 and Brucella revisions 1 and 2 remain rejected review evidence. Publication requires exact-file, embedded-metadata, approved-review-log, accessibility, identifier, registry, search, and corpus gates.
